decision: Keep .env.example, .env.demo and secrets.example/* tracked as intentional templates; keep generated caches (.uv-cache, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache) ignored; apply no git-policy add-ignore rules.
rationale: git-policy-review produced 158 confirm-only entries and zero add-ignore proposals: 146 are source-like files inside already-ignored .uv-cache, and the remaining tracked hits are template/config files the repository intentionally versions. No unignored sensitive material was found.
title: Accept git-audit template and cache confirm findings
